about: Known tab-like controls per file that are not view tabs (see designSystemTabsScan.mjs). Counts may only go down: a new tab-like control must be SegmentedTabs.

chat/WorkspaceSidePanelPreviewTabs.tsx.reason: Closable editor-style tabs of the preview files opened in the chat side panel (one per open file, with ✕); a document strip, not page views.

mobile/TabBar.tsx.reason: The phone app's bottom navigation between its areas (Home, Chats, Runs, Work, More): app navigation in thumb reach, like the desktop's area rail, not view tabs inside a page.
